summary: find options: age with units and negative values, age_stamp (mtime/atime/ctime), checksum algorithm, contains regex, depth, encoding, and exact_mode.
questions: How do I find files older than 7 days?
How do I find files modified recently (younger than an hour)?
How do I search file contents with the find module?
How do I limit recursion depth in find?
Can find use access time instead of modification time?

answer_card.title: find parameters: age, contents, depth
answer_card.answer_md:
- `age`: ≥ age; negative = ≤ age. Units `s`,`m`,`h`,`d`,`w` (e.g. `1w`, `-1h`)
- `age_stamp`: `mtime` (default), `atime`, `ctime`
- `contains`: regex on content (files only); line-start match unless `read_whole_file`
- `depth`: max levels (`recurse: false` = depth 1)
- `checksum_algorithm` (sha1), `encoding`, `exact_mode` (true)
